MARS-LAKE.name: Martian crater-lake mudstones (Gale crater; Jezero crater delta-lake system)

location.site: Gale crater, Murray formation / Yellowknife Bay

properties.statement: fine-grained mudstone and siltstone
deposited in long-lived crater lakes
no ocean-margin setting in these crater lakes: marine deposits are a different process
desiccation cracks recording lake drying
repeated wet-dry cycles (polygonal salt-enriched patterns)
finely laminated mudstone
clay minerals (smectite) in mudstone (CheMin XRD)
calcium-sulfate veins (later diagenetic, not primary lake salts)
at Jezero the lake-delta deposits sit on igneous crater-floor units
Earth-only check: heating by nearby intrusions changes mudstones; not reported at Gale/Jezero lake beds

MARS-SERP.name: Jezero crater floor: olivine-rich igneous rocks altered by water (serpentinization, carbonates)
not_comparable: Fe-rich (Mars) vs Mg-rich (Earth) olivine and serpentine
humid weathering and vegetation on Earth

properties.statement: olivine cumulate (olivine-rich ultramafic rock); pyroxenite/hornblendite/gabbro are different rocks
in situ evidence for serpentinization and H2 production
Fe-rich serpentine
Mg-Fe carbonate (magnesite-siderite) in floor rocks
olivine

MARS-LAVA.name: Basaltic lava plains and crater-floor lavas (InSight landing site; Jezero Maaz formation)

properties.statement: basaltic igneous rock
erupted as lava flows at the surface
an intrusion (sill/dike) cooled underground: a different emplacement process
Earth-side indicator of lava meeting water (relevant to Jezero's later lake); not observed on Mars
at Jezero, lake-delta sediments overlie the crater-floor igneous units

limitations: evidence comes from map text and structured lithology at map scale (1:100,000 to 1:250,000 here); it is not field observation
minerals named in map descriptions are recorded as 'mapped mention', not as measured mineralogy
steep ground (>= 25 deg on ~20 m DEM) is a proxy for possible outcrop; it is not confirmed rock
public access means PAD-US 'Open access' land; trails may not reach the steep cells
D435 suitability cannot be judged remotely beyond 'steep public ground exists'
Macrostrat environment entries marked 'inferred' are database defaults and are not used as evidence
